phase: 13 -- Florida DBPR public-lodging licence registry, and the Phase 4 / Phase 33 county and named-place boundary audit
terms: Published unauthenticated on the official state page under 'Public Records'; Florida public-lodging licence records are public records (re-verified by PTF-DISCOVERY-P0-001). Bulk-file download, no crawl.
a_licence_is_not_a_policy: A DBPR licence is state identity and eligibility evidence for the licensed premises. It never carries or implies a pet policy.
a_licensee_name_is_not_a_hotel_name: Both Business Name and Licensee Name are recorded on every lead so the census lane can apply the West Palm Beach identity-correction rule: a record whose Business Name EQUALS its Licensee Name carries a LICENSEE identity, never a hotel trade name, and the longer string never wins on length alone.
dbpr_does_not_decide_geography: A licence's county and city are the LICENSING record. Admission is decided by the property's own postal code against the corridor registry, and nothing else. This lane reports both so the two can be compared, which is exactly how the four-county split is audited.

exclusions.CNDO: VACATION_RENTAL_OR_RESORT_RESIDENCE -- a resort condominium unit licensed individually
exclusions.DWEL: VACATION_RENTAL -- a resort / vacation dwelling (whole-home rental) licensed individually

lee.ruling: ADMITTED, MUNICIPALITIES PRESERVED. Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Fort Myers Beach, Sanibel, Estero and Bonita Springs are admitted with Gateway / RSW, South Fort Myers / Iona and East Fort Myers; North Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres / Alva and Captiva at FRINGE. Pine Island (Bokeelia, St. James City, Pineland), Cabbage Key, Useppa, North Captiva and Boca Grande (Gasparilla Island) are refused.

collier.ruling: REFUSED WHOLE. Naples, North Naples, Marco Island, Everglades City, Immokalee and Ave Maria are future standalone markets. A premises the State licenses in Collier County is refused even where its mailing label reads Bonita Springs (34134 north of the county line) -- COUNTY_REFUSALS.

charlotte.ruling: REFUSED WHOLE. Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte, Englewood, Placida and Rotonda are future standalone markets; Boca Grande (Lee County, Gasparilla Island) is refused with them.

hendry / glades / sarasota / manatee / d.ruling: REFUSED. LaBelle, Clewiston, Sarasota, Bradenton, Venice, North Port and Arcadia are not absorbed.

unit_licensed_premises.what_it_is: Every admitted-code premises (house number + street + ZIP) the State licenses BY THE UNIT -- resort-condominium (CNDO) or vacation-dwelling (DWEL) licences, with their counts. A premises carrying such licences and NO hotel-rank licence is a condominium / vacation-rental operation on the State's own record; the census refuses a map or bureau 'resort' there unless a hotel-rank licence or a hotel brand reaches it.
